stint_completed_when: end_lap row state_time_s <= T (end_observed_at_s joined server-side from the lap grid)
new_compound_observable_when: active stint compound is read from the causal frame DriverRaceState at T, never from the entity future
backfill_rule: entity compounds apply ONLY to completed stints; the active stint never inherits entity data beyond its past-observed start
pit_transition_window: between a stint end observation and the next stint start observation the frame stint identity may be null -> explicit unavailable, not inferred

restart_tie_quirk.where: 2021-r08-R stroll laps 4/5 share state_time_s 2349.136 (red-flag restart lap; lap 5 has null lap_time)
restart_tie_quirk.handling: both visible at the same T via <=; ordered by lap_number; only tie in 2973 driver-races, zero decreases

state_vs_sector3_skew: p50 -0.033s (state_time precedes sector_3_end by ~33ms); tails to -5553s under red flags; LAP_END joint-reveal rule absorbs the skew
current_tyre_preserved: V3.10C frame facts (compound/tyre_life/stint) unchanged; F adds no reinterpretation
